We have an incident: inventory p95 latency above 800ms. We looked at service_status: p95 1445ms. Logs show OOMKilled restarts. CPU 45, mem 94, err 0.28. So memory usage high, maybe memory limit not set causing OOM kills. We changed config: set memory_limit 2Gi. Then restarted service. Health now green.

We must determine cause. It was bad config? Actually the memory limit was maybe missing or too low. We set memory_limit. The root cause could be "bad_config" for inventory service. Also maybe "memory_leak" but no evidence. The logs show OOM kills. Setting memory limit probably allowed proper allocation. The root cause: missing or incorrect memory limit config. So we should finish: cause "bad_config", root_cause_service "inventory", summary explaining.
